items.headline: Angel Flores has TD pass, scoring run as Central Michigan beats Akron 41-17 in MAC opener
items.description: — Angel Flores rushed for 154 yards and a touchdown and threw for another score as Central Michigan beat Akron 41-17 on Saturday in a Mid-American Conference opener for both teams.

items.headline: Jai’Den Thomas has 167 total yards and 3 touchdowns to lead UNLV past Akron 38-10
items.description: — Jackson Arnold threw for 290 yards and three touchdowns, Jai’Den Thomas had 167 total yards and three touchdowns, and UNLV beat Akron 38-10 on Saturday.

items.description: UNLV (1-2) at Akron (1-2), Sept. 26 at 12 p.m. EDT.
